# Allometrics

> > ISO/IEC 17025 accredited calibration and certification laboratory serving North America with NIST-traceable metrology services across electronics, dimensional, mass, temperature, and pressure measurement instruments.

Allometrics is a 50+ year old metrology and calibration company specializing in ISO 17025 accredited laboratory services. They serve pharmaceutical, manufacturing, and research sectors with NIST-traceable certifications and GMP/FDA compliance support across diverse instrument categories.

## Key Topics

- ISO 17025 Accreditation
- NIST Traceability
- Calibration Services
- Metrology
- GMP/FDA Compliance
- Quality Control
- Laboratory Equipment
- A2LA Accreditation
- Regulatory Compliance
- Pharmaceutical Testing
- Certification Services
- Compliance Documentation
- Precision Measurement
- Equipment Validation
- IQOQ Qualification

## Calibration Services by Instrument Type

- [Electronics Calibration Services](https://allometrics.com/services/electronics-calibration): Electronics calibration services including multimeters, NIST traceable
- [Multimeter Calibration](https://allometrics.com/services/electronics-calibration/multimeter-calibration-services): Multimeter calibration for Fluke, Agilent with NIST traceability
- [Weight & Balance Calibration](https://allometrics.com/services/weight-calibration-services): Weight calibration (1mg-10kg) with audit-ready NIST traceable certificates
- [Balance Calibration Services](https://allometrics.com/services/balance-calibration): Balance calibration for analytical instruments with regulatory compliance
- [Laboratory Scale Calibration](https://allometrics.com/services/laboratory-balance-and-scale-calibration): Lab scale calibration with ISO 17025 accreditation and NIST traceability
- [Gravimetric Testing Services](https://allometrics.com/services/gravimetric-testing): Gravimetric testing for balances, scales, weights with NIST traceability
- [Dimensional Calibration Services](https://allometrics.com/services/dimensional-calibration): Dimensional calibration for calipers, micrometers with NIST traceability
- [Caliper Calibration Services](https://allometrics.com/services/caliper-calibration-services): Caliper calibration for Mitutoyo digital and mechanical calipers
- [Micrometer Calibration Services](https://allometrics.com/services/micrometer-calibration): Micrometer calibration with ISO 17025 accreditation and NIST traceability
- [Gage Block Calibration](https://allometrics.com/services/gage-block-calibration): Gage block calibration for precision measurement standards
- [Pressure Calibration Services](https://allometrics.com/services/pressure-calibration-services): Pressure calibration for gauges and transducers with expedited service
- [Thermometer Calibration Services](https://allometrics.com/services/thermometer-calibration): Thermometer calibration with 48-hour expedited service available

## Specialized Testing & Validation

- [Centrifuge Calibration & Certification](https://allometrics.com/services/centrifuge-calibration-certification): Centrifuge calibration for Eppendorf, Thermo Scientific equipment
- [Freezer Calibration Services](https://allometrics.com/services/freezer-calibration-services): Freezer calibration for vaccine storage and pharmaceutical compliance
- [Temperature Mapping Services](https://allometrics.com/services/temperature-humidity-and-pressure-mapping): Temperature mapping for GMP/FDA compliance with IQOQ qualification

## Service Programs & Support

- [Allometrics Service Assurance Program (ASAP)](https://allometrics.com/services/allometrics-service-assurance-program-asap): ASAP membership program with preventive maintenance and response guarantees
- [Access Your Certificates](https://allometrics.com/access-your-certificates): Customer portal for accessing calibration certificates and account login
- [Contact Us](https://allometrics.com/contact-us): Contact information for service inquiries across US, Canada, Mexico
